Bloom patches (2026-10-14): main-queue async request serialization; all GATT descriptor callbacks must finish before one session-ready callback; reset connection maps; ignore callbacks from other peripherals; explicit Bloom provisioning service; fallback service discovery without advertised UUID; distinguish Bluetooth state from empty scans. Stage-only diagnostics exclude secrets and packet data.
Security1/session cryptography/protobuf retained. Upstream verbose logs disabled.
